mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the 3-month Treasury yield indicates a tightening monetary policy cycle that raises discount rates, compressing the present value of future equity cash flows and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the 3-month Treasury yield signals a shift toward monetary easing, lowering discount rates and increasing the present value of future equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) coinciding with rising consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) suggests a labor market strengthening that supports wage growth and corporate optimism, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) amid rising consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates labor market weakness that dampens corporate optimism and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly acceleration in industrial production (INDPRO) signals improving supply chain conditions that reduce production costs and support corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in normalization periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly deceleration in industrial production (INDPRO) amid rising consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates supply chain disruptions that raise input costs and compress margins, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in disruption periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in retail sales (HOUST) and a rise in unemployment (UNRATE) together indicate weakening consumer demand that compresses corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
